title: Products ordered by every customer who ordered
statementMd:
List products that were ordered (any status) by at least 3 different customers. Show name and customer count.

Expected columns: `name`, `customers`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) >= 3;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
